title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering during regional failover
author: Evelyn Chen
description: Motivation: intermittent incidents in US-west triggered by an edge-case race in the SLO enforcer backoff ordering which caused lower-priority requests to be backoff-bypassed and regional failover to trigger prematurely. Root cause: comparator used for backoff queue allowed non-deterministic ordering when timestamps were equal and the backoff entry could be superseded by a concurrently arriving failover signal. Impact: customers observed higher-than-expected failovers and circuit-breaker trips during short bursts, increasing tail latency and error budgets. This PR fixes the ordering/race and adds guards to prevent superseded backoff entries from affecting failover decisions. Changes include: deterministic comparator for backoff queue, a supersede-check on dequeue, tighter atomic updates for regional failover state, additional metrics and tracing points, integration + chaos tests, and a focused rollout plan. Testing: unit tests, new integration test that reproduces the race, and a small chaos harness run in staging. Rollout: squash-merge to main, canary deploy to us-west-canary (10% traffic) for 30m, monitor slo_enforcer.backoff.ordering_errors, slo_enforcer.failover_count, circuit_breaker.trips, and token-level latency; if stable, promote to region. Rollback: revert to previous enforcer image and flip the feature flag. Checklist: [x] deterministic comparator implemented [x] supersede-check added [x] metrics + traces [x] unit tests [x] integration/chaos tests [x] rollout doc update.
commits: Fix: deterministic comparator for backoff queue to remove non-determinism when timestamps equal (services/slo-enforcer/backoff.go)
Feat: add isSuperseded check on dequeue to ignore obsolete backoff entries (services/slo-enforcer/backoff.go)
Fix: atomic update for regional_failover_state to avoid concurrent write races (services/slo-enforcer/decision.go)
Test: add integration reproduction test for backoff ordering race (tests/integration/slo_enforcer_failover_test.go)
Docs: runbook update for regional failover rollout and rollback steps (docs/ops/runbooks/regional-failover.md)
